state.paragraph: agreed to enter into a confidentiality agreement), Party B, Party C and CSC/Pamplona to provide these parties with access to high level information concerning Mac-Gray's technology, pipeline, management team, regional operations, contracts, operations and growth initiatives, and in the case of CSC/Pamplona and Party A, synergies, and to then request that each of these parties submit a revised indication of interest. After discussion and in an effort to drive offers with increased value, the Special Committee authorized and instructed BofA Merrill Lynch to proceed with the staged disclosure as discussed at this meeting and to reach out to each of the four interested bidders and arrange management meetings.

ledger_rows.Note: Preliminary indication at the round-1 due date; no substantive diligence access yet (management meetings began in August).
Inferred: 20 signers minus Party B, Party C and CSC/Pamplona (submitted) and Party A (recorded; still negotiating NDA) leaves 16 non-submitters; signing dates unstated, so some may be late entrants.
Preliminary indication submitted after the 07/23/2013 due date; no substantive diligence access yet.
Oral preliminary indication delivered by telephone to BofA Merrill Lynch; written indication followed on 07/25/2013.
Round 2 opened: Special Committee advanced Party A, Party B, Party C and CSC/Pamplona to management meetings and staged diligence, then revised indications.
Written indication replacing Party C's prior oral $15.00–$17.00 indication.
Signed after non-solicitation terms were agreed 07/27/2013; informational package provided to potentially improve the June 21 proposal.

nda_access.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a party signs a confidentiality agreement, or is given (or denied) data room access, management meetings, projections or other diligence information. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
